purpose: Test whether giving the planner-aware loss a within-context action slate repairs candidate ranking at fixed h256 Dhigh context support, training budget, and action-conditioned predictor interface.

research_question.primary: At fixed h256, 256-context Dhigh support, and 1500 updates, does adding a fixed planner-aware listwise KL over multiple action queries from the same context improve held-out candidate ranking over the identical slate-trained latent-MSE control?
research_question.mechanism: A single action query per context supplies pointwise latent regression, while a within-context slate supplies relative planner-order supervision. The treatment changes only the training objective; the student inference interface is unchanged.
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; the 300 candidates inside a block are nested measurements, not independent replicates
research_question.primary_comparison: slate_rank treatment minus slate_mse control at step 1500
research_question.external_reference: The completed h256-Dhigh density result is descriptive context, not the paired control for this experiment.

scope.observation_encoder_scope: out of scope; use cached native observation latents

prior_evidence.optimization_length: FAIL: 1500-step extension did not materially improve ranking
prior_evidence.capacity_h256: FAIL: h256 did not improve ranking over h128 at the frozen budget
prior_evidence.context_density: FAIL effect gate, but all 16 Spearman deltas were positive and Dhigh/Dlow logged teacher-relative MSE ratio was 0.5001
prior_evidence.old_rankdistill: Two-anchor paired ranking smoke passed its narrow paired direction, but absolute fidelity and latent non-inferiority failed

entry_context.authorization: The next factor is the missing within-context action-ranking supervision, not another capacity, step, or context-density retune.
entry_context.not_a_retest: This cell changes the supervision structure and action-slate grouping; it must not be described as a rerun of the old 500-step rank-distill cell.

train_context_pool.source: the exact completed Dhigh context-density manifest
train_context_pool.manifest_policy: Preserve the manifest rows, feature values, targets, episode IDs, ordinals, and order exactly; do not regenerate, reorder, subsample, or add trajectories.

heldout_split.heldout_exclusion: No held-out context, action, seed, candidate, or goal may enter training.

external_dhigh_reference.allowed_use: Report absolute ranking, logged-action relative MSE, causality, and predictor-only latency beside the new arms; do not subtract Dhigh metrics to define the primary slate effect.
external_dhigh_reference.forbidden_use: Do not claim the new treatment beats Dhigh as a causal or paired comparison, because its initialization, context schedule, and query schedule are not the paired control defined here.

slate_mse_control.name: slate latent-MSE control
slate_mse_control.loss: mean dense native-latent MSE over the 32 query rows

slate_rank_treatment.name: slate planner-aware rank treatment
slate_rank_treatment.loss: mean dense native-latent MSE over the 32 query rows plus fixed planner-aware listwise KL

arms.pairing: Both arms receive the same initial state dictionary, context schedule, exact precomputed action slates, detached teacher targets, optimizer hyperparameters, update count, snapshot schedule, held-out candidate bank, and timing inputs. Only the treatment rank-loss term is different.

initialization.procedure: Create one fresh h256 student, clone its initial state dictionary into two students, and create independent AdamW optimizer states from the same initial parameter values.

action_query_slate.definition: Each selected training context contributes one fixed four-query slate. Query slot 0 is retained primary logged action; slots 1-3 are planner-like counterfactual action prefixes.
action_query_slate.normalized_action_coordinate_system: the same normalized primitive-action coordinates consumed by the official DINO-WM predictor

primary_logged.source: the selected Dhigh train-manifest context's real five-token action prefix
primary_logged.student_target: frozen teacher rollout for this exact prefix

one_step_cem_resample.score: frozen teacher terminal objective for the same context goal
one_step_cem_resample.resample: one diagonal Normal sample using elite mean and per-coordinate max(variance,0.05)

distinctness.requirement: All four prefixes in every context slate must be pairwise distinct by exact tensor comparison.
distinctness.validation: Check the precomputed slate bank before step 1; a collision invalidates the cell.
distinctness.replacement_policy: No result-dependent resampling or retuning is allowed; a deterministic seed collision is an invalid run.

action_query_slate.precomputation: Generate the complete 256-context x 4-query slate bank on CPU before the first update, then use immutable lookup during both arms.

context_schedule.sampling: eight distinct context ordinals per update
context_schedule.schedule_generation: Use a CPU generator to make a fresh permutation of 0..255 every 32 updates and consume eight consecutive ordinals per update; continue the fixed sequence for 1500 updates.
context_schedule.approximately_balanced_exposure: Every context is exposed 46 or 47 times over 12000 context slots.
context_schedule.role_schedule: No independent logged/Gaussian/CEM role permutation; the four slots are fixed within every context slate.

teacher_targets.input: cached native observation latent z_t plus each exact normalized five-step action prefix
teacher_targets.target_generation: Generate one detached teacher target for each of the 1024 precomputed slate rows before step 1; both arms use identical target rows.
teacher_targets.goal_usage: The context goal is used only for CEM proposal scoring and planner-aware training/evaluation costs; it is never concatenated with or passed into the student.

batch_semantics.reason: A rank group must remain complete inside the single microbatch; no partial-slate gradient or cross-microbatch KL is permitted.

training.rng_policy: Generate initialization, context schedule, Gaussian actions, CEM proposals, held-out candidates, and timing candidates with explicit CPU generators before GPU transfer; do not use result-dependent RNG calls.
training.arm_update_order: At even updates evaluate/update control then treatment; at odd updates treatment then control. The order counterbalances same-GPU sequencing while the inputs remain identical.

loss_reduction.latent_mse: mean over all 32 query rows, horizons, and native latent dimensions
loss_reduction.rank_group_kl: mean over the eight complete four-query context slates

planner_aware_loss.rank_group: the four action queries sharing one context ordinal in one update; no cross-context ranking
planner_aware_loss.cost: official terminal latent-to-goal objective at horizon 5
planner_aware_loss.standardization: z-score the four costs within each group using group mean and std floor 1e-6
planner_aware_loss.fixed_from: the previous rank-distillation smoke protocol; no new weight or temperature sweep

ranking.candidate_distribution: the existing frozen CPU-generated normalized Gaussian candidate bank
ranking.shared_inputs: The same held-out context, candidate action tensor, goal, and frozen teacher costs are used for control, treatment, and teacher.

logged_action_fidelity.action: each heldout context's real logged action prefix

causality.procedure: For each arm and each prefix horizon k, change only action tokens after k while keeping z_t and the first k tokens fixed.
causality.metric: maximum absolute output difference at horizon k

latency.boundary: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through frozen teacher rollout or one student forward

heldout_evaluation.telemetry: During GPU execution append utilization and VRAM samples every 30 seconds to the job log.

slate_ranking_effect.comparison: slate_rank treatment - slate_mse control at step 1500

latent_noninferiority.comparison: slate_rank treatment / slate_mse control on heldout logged-action teacher-relative MSE

decision_levels.paired_effect: PASS iff paired_integrity and all four slate_ranking_effect thresholds pass.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff paired_integrity, slate_ranking_effect, treatment absolute fidelity, treatment/control MSE non-inferiority, and treatment predictor-only latency all pass.
decision_levels.slate_supported_replacement: GO iff paired_effect and full_replacement are both GO.
decision_levels.invalidity: If pairing, slate distinctness, manifest, or integrity is invalid, report NO-GO and do not interpret ranking deltas.
decision_levels.no_retuning: Any failed gate is preserved; do not change lambda, temperature, slate composition, steps, seeds, or thresholds after observing results.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_paired_effect_pass: Under this frozen DINO-WM PushT predictor-level contract, adding a fixed within-context action-query slate plus planner-aware listwise KL improves held-out candidate ranking over the identical slate-trained latent-MSE control.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_replacement_go: The treatment meets the stated predictor-level replacement gates while preserving the action-conditioned inference interface.
claim_boundary.external_dhigh_sentence: Dhigh is a descriptive context-support reference only; it is not evidence for the paired treatment effect.
forbidden: full planner or closed-loop task success
multi-step CEM integration or end-to-end control latency
causal claims beyond this paired cell

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as the primary result artifact.
